name: aftergap-tokenized-stocks
description: AfterGap Agentic Skill for autonomous tokenized stock arbitrage and optimal routing across bStocks, Ondo, and xStocks on BNB Smart Chain (BSC 56).
author: kellycryptos

tools.name: inspect_gap
tools.description: Compare on-chain prices of a tokenized stock across bStocks, Ondo, and xStocks against the Friday cash reference price. Returns the cheapest wrapper, basis spread, and direct dollar savings.

tools.name: quote_best_route
tools.description: Fetches a live signed quote for the optimal (cheapest) stock wrapper on BSC using the Binance Web3 Trading API aggregator (LiquidMesh / RFQ mode).

amountUsdt.description: The amount in USDT to swap (e.g. 10).

userWalletAddress.description: Optional recipient BSC wallet address (defaults to configured agent wallet).

tools.name: simulate_swap
tools.description: Performs an on-chain eth_call dry-run simulation on BNB Smart Chain mainnet without spending gas to verify execution before committing funds.

quoteId.description: The quote ID returned by quote_best_route.

toTokenAddress.description: Contract address of the tokenized stock being purchased.

amountUsdt.description: Amount of USDT in the swap.

tools.name: scan_thematic_basket
tools.description: Scans an entire thematic stock basket ('mag7', 'ai_semis', or 'buffett') across all token wrappers and returns the constituents ranked by largest arbitrage spread.

basket.description: Name of the thematic basket to scan.
